'''Godol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]. She participated in the [[Invasion of Manaan]], where she was killed. She wielded an [[RH-34 Starforged assault cannon]].<ref name="TOR:Restoration" />
